insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited

good.name: PED Waiting
good.quote: PED waiting period 36 months ( For pre existing diseases other than the pre-existing Disability and HIV/AIDS covered)
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases other than disability and HIV/AIDS have a 36-month waiting period, which is within the normal market range of 2 to 4 years. This means you can claim for these conditions after three years of continuous coverage.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: First 30 days waiting period- Code- Excl03
good.explanation: Illnesses have a 30-day waiting period, which is standard; accidents are typically exempt from this waiting period. This means you cannot claim for illnesses during the first 30 days of the policy.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Specified disease/procedure waiting period- Code- Excl02 ... excluded until the expiry of 24months
good.explanation: Specified diseases and procedures have a 24-month waiting period, which aligns with industry standards. This means claims for these conditions are eligible after two years.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: for a fixed period of 30 days prior to the date of admissible Hospitalization
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 30 days before hospitalization are covered, which is a standard benefit. This helps cover diagnostic tests and treatments before hospital admission.

bad.name: PED Waiting
bad.quote: Any treatment for the pre-existing disability covered, will have a waiting period of 24 months from the first policy inception date.
bad.reference: Section 6 (Specific Conditions Applicable for Persons with Disability)
bad.explanation: Pre-existing disability has a 24-month waiting period, which is longer than the best market standard of 12 months but still acceptable. This means you can claim for pre-existing disabilities after two years of continuous coverage.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: Room Rent, Boarding, Nursing Expenses as provided by the Hospital / Nursing Home up to maximum of 1% of the Sum Insured per day.
bad.explanation: Room rent is capped at 1% of the Sum Insured per day, limiting room choice and potentially increasing out-of-pocket expenses if hospital charges exceed this cap.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Each and every claim under the Policy shall be subject to a Co-payment of 20% ... This co-payment can be waived off by paying an additional premium(optional).
bad.explanation: A mandatory 20% co-pay applies to every claim by default, significantly reducing effective coverage unless the co-pay waiver is purchased.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: subject to a limit of Rs.40,000/-, per each eye in one policy year.
bad.explanation: Cataract treatment has a fixed sub-limit of Rs.40,000 per eye per year, which may be insufficient and lead to higher out-of-pocket costs.

bad.name: Modern Treatments
bad.quote: will be covered ... up to 50% of Sum Insured
bad.explanation: Coverage for modern treatments is limited to 50% of the Sum Insured, which can be restrictive for expensive procedures.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Non-Payable items: The expenses that are not covered in this Policy are placed under List -I of Annexure-11
bad.reference: Section 8.2(17) and Annexure II (Non-Medical Expenses / List I)
bad.explanation: Consumables and many hospital items like gloves and masks are excluded, resulting in routine out-of-pocket expenses.

bad.name: Restore Benefit
bad.quote: Maximum liability of the Company under all such Claims paid under indemnity, during each Policy Year shall be the Sum Insured opted and specified in the Schedule.
bad.explanation: No restore or reinstatement benefit is provided; once the Sum Insured is exhausted in a policy year, no further coverage is available.

bad.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
bad.quote: for a fixed period of 60 days from the date of discharge from the Hospital
bad.explanation: Post-hospitalization expenses are covered for only 60 days, which is the minimum common duration and may not cover longer recovery periods.

unclear.name: No-Claim Bonus
unclear.quote: Maximum liability of the Company under all such Claims paid under indemnity, during each Policy Year shall be the Sum Insured opted and specified in the Schedule.
unclear.reference: Section 2 (Operating Clause) / Table of Benefits (no NCB field shown)
unclear.explanation: No explicit mention of No-Claim Bonus or renewal bonus is found; confirmation from the policy schedule or brochure is needed to determine if any bonus applies.
